scope: Read-only installed npm v3 two-lock metadata cross-check against 612 declared-closure manifests

audit.scope: read-only installed manifests and both npm v3 lock metadata snapshots

bundledNoIntegrityClarification.interpretation: A bundled package does not require a separately downloaded archive integrity entry; this is NOT a proof of bundle byte integrity.

limitations: Both npm lockfiles and the installed package tree reside beneath the historically broad-write H: namespace; consistency is NOT independent trust or a signature.
The exact lock entry check compares recorded metadata and versions, but does not hash downloaded archives against npm registry provenance or inspect package-lock signing keys.
An integrity field being present is not the same as validating its content or the source bytes loaded by the active Node process.
The path check and file reads are point-in-time, not race-free handle-based object identity or qualified ancestor rights.
Not all optional/peer, dynamic JavaScript, native module, browser/PDF or downloaded helper runtime paths are proven by declared manifest and lockfile metadata.
GitHub-hosted Windows/Linux acceptance on draft PR45 is required before source release; this does not authorize DEV or live production changes.
